page.title: Marbella Sunset Cruise with Champagne & Tapas 2040: Evening Elegance

data.meta_description: Book a Marbella sunset cruise with champagne & tapas 2040. Enjoy 2-hour evening sail from Puerto Banús with sparkling cava, snacks, and skyline views. Reserve now.
data.summary: Experience a Marbella sunset cruise with champagne & tapas 2040 departing from Puerto Banús. This 2-hour evening charter includes cava, tapas, and a front-row seat to the Costa del Sol sunset.

faq.q: What is included in the Marbella sunset cruise with champagne & tapas?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). The tapas-style snacks are served alongside cava as you watch the sunset.

faq.q: Which boats are available for the sunset cruise?
faq.a: The sunset cruise is available on our Tier A boats: the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 guests) and the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 guests). Both depart from Puerto Banús and are ideal for an intimate evening experience.

faq.q: How long is the sunset cruise and what time does it depart?
faq.a: The cruise lasts 2 hours. Departure is scheduled 1 hour before sunset, typically between 19:00 and 20:00 depending on the season. You'll return after dusk with the Marbella lights twinkling.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food or drinks?
faq.a: All drinks and snacks are provided as part of the charter. You are welcome to bring additional food or drinks, but the included cava and tapas are designed to complement the sunset experience. No extra charge for personal items.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad?
faq.a: Your safety is paramount. If the captain deems conditions unsafe (e.g., high winds or storms), we will reschedule your cruise at no extra cost or issue a full refund. You'll be notified at least 2 hours before departure.

faq.q: Is the sunset cruise suitable for children?
faq.a: Yes, children are welcome on board. The boats have safety equipment for all ages. Please let us know in advance if you need a child life jacket. The cruise is family-friendly, with soft drinks and snacks included.

faq.q: Can I book a private sunset cruise for a special occasion?
faq.a: Absolutely. The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 are perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, proposals, or small celebrations. Contact us via WhatsApp to arrange personalised decorations or a custom menu (extra charges may apply).

faq.q: How do I book and what is the cancellation policy?
faq.a: Book directly through our website or via WhatsApp. A 50% deposit secures your date, with the balance due 7 days before departure. Cancellations made 14+ days in advance receive a full refund; 7–13 days, 50% refund; under 7 days, no refund.

data.body_html:
There is no better way to end a Marbella day than aboard a private motor yacht, cruising the Costa del Sol as the sun sinks into the Mediterranean. Our Marbella sunset cruise with champagne & tapas 2040 is a two-hour evening charter from Puerto Banús, designed for couples, small groups, and anyone craving a touch of elegance. With sparkling cava, light tapas, and the silhouette of La Concha mountain behind you, this is the quintessential Marbella sunset experience.

What to expect on your sunset cruise

Your evening begins at Puerto Banús, where you'll board one of our premium Tier A motor yachts — the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 guests) or the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 guests). Both boats offer a spacious flybridge, comfortable seating, and a shaded saloon. As you cast off, your licensed skipper will guide you along the Marbella coastline, past the Golden Mile and the Marbella Marina, towards the open sea. The onboard cooler is stocked with chilled cava, white wine, beer, soft drinks, and water, plus a selection of light tapas snacks — olives, almonds, local cheeses, and cured meats. The 2-hour duration gives you ample time to relax, take photos, and simply soak in the 2040 sunset colours.

Pricing and booking details

This experience is available on our Tier A boats at a fixed rate: €749 for 2 hours (€2,299 for a full 8-hour day charter). The price includes the licensed skipper, fuel, all drinks and snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden fees. For larger groups or custom requests, contact us via WhatsApp for a personalised quote. Bookings require a 50% deposit; the balance is due 7 days before departure. Cancellations made 14+ days in advance receive a full refund.

The perfect evening itinerary

Your sunset cruise typically departs 1 hour before sunset — between 19:00 and 20:00 depending on the season. The route heads west along the coast, offering uninterrupted views of the Marbella skyline, the La Concha mountain, and the distant Estepona hills. As the sun dips below the horizon, the sky turns shades of orange, pink, and purple — a spectacle best enjoyed with a glass of cava in hand. The skipper will anchor at a calm spot near Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for the final moments of daylight. You'll return to Puerto Banús after dusk, with the marina lights reflecting on the water.

Why choose a private sunset cruise over a group tour?

A private charter offers exclusivity, flexibility, and personalised service. Unlike crowded group sunset tours, you control the music, the pace, and the company. The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 are well-maintained, comfortable yachts with plenty of space for socialising or quiet moments. The included cava and tapas elevate the experience without the need for extra planning. Whether it's a romantic evening, a birthday celebration, or a corporate reward, a private sunset cruise ensures memories that last long after the sun sets.

What to bring and wear

Evening temperatures on the water can be cooler than on land, especially after sunset. Bring a light jacket or sweater. Comfortable shoes with non-slip soles are recommended. Don't forget your camera or phone for photos — the sunset views are spectacular. Sunscreen is still advisable even in the late afternoon. All drinks and snacks are provided, but you are welcome to bring additional food or drinks if you wish. Life jackets are available for all guests, including children.

Other sunset charter options

If your group is larger or you prefer a different style, we offer sunset cruises on other boats in our fleet. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 guests) includes a free jet ski and starts at €4,719 for 4 hours. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 guests) and the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 guests) are also available — pricing on request. For a more intimate outing, the Speedboat (7m, 6 guests) or Red Tide (11m, 6 guests) offer a faster, sportier experience. Contact us via WhatsApp to discuss the best option for your group.

Explore more Marbella experiences

Looking for other ways to enjoy the coast? Browse our full range of Marbella boat rentals for day charters, fishing trips, and custom itineraries. From the Astondoa 40 to the Ferretti 94, we have a boat for every occasion. Book your sunset cruise today and discover why the Costa del Sol sunset is legendary.
